audit_items.proof_trace: Production builds lack synchronization on BlobSchedule slice during MaxBlobsPerBlock lookup. Concurrent P2P block validations trigger data race in slices.SortFunc, causing wrong max-blob-count value or crash. Race allows blocks exceeding limit to pass validation or valid blocks to be rejected.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends concurrent P2P blocks with different slots when BlobSchedule is unsorted. Race in MaxBlobsPerBlock returns wrong limit value, enabling consensus violations (accepting oversize blocks) or DoS (rejecting valid blocks).
